subject: Cancellation for subscription
originalBody:
Hi there, 

I’m really sorry but I need to cancel my subscription for the Panzi foundation. The only reason is that I’m struggling to keep up with my outgoings. I do want to support and I will try to as and when I can. 

Please cancel my subscription.
draftBody:
Dear Sienna,

Thank you so much for reaching out, and please know that your support over time has meant a great deal to us and to the survivors we serve. We completely understand that circumstances change, and we are grateful for every contribution you have made.

We have passed your cancellation request along to our Director of Development, Stephanie Rapp, who will follow up with you shortly to confirm that everything has been taken care of.

We hope to stay connected with you, and whenever you feel ready to give again — in any amount or form — we will be honored to welcome you back. Thank you again, Sienna, for your kindness and your belief in our mission.

With gratitude,
The Panzi Foundation Team
